cohort: 191 pregnant women with hypothyroidism and 191 pregnant women with normal thyroid levels, all singleton pregnancies and no other comorbidities, consulting at Royal Hospital (Muscat, Oman) from January 2012 to December 2014.
finding: Pregnant women with hypothyroidism had a higher risk of obstetric and neonatal complications, including cesarean delivery, miscarriage, postpartum hemorrhage, low birth weight, structural fetal anomalies, and prematurity.
